package config

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

type Config struct {
	HTTPAddr                       string
	DatabaseURL                    string
	NATSURL                        string
	InternalAPIToken               string
	TeacherServiceToken            string
	TeacherOnboardingHandoffToken  string
	PracticeServiceToken           string
	GraphReadinessEnabled          bool
	OnboardingHandoffEnabled       bool
	OnboardingPathExecutionEnabled bool
	StudentServiceURL              string
	StudentServiceToken            string
	StudentServiceWriteToken       string
	CourseServiceURL               string
	CourseServiceToken             string
	AIPromptServiceURL             string
	AIPromptServiceToken           string
	DownstreamHTTPTimeout          time.Duration
	WorkerPollInterval             time.Duration
	WorkerLeaseTTL                 time.Duration
	WorkerMaxAttempts              int
	OutboxPollInterval             time.Duration
	OutboxLockTTL                  time.Duration
	OutboxPublishTimeout           time.Duration
	OutboxRetryBase                time.Duration
	OutboxRetryMax                 time.Duration
	OutboxBatchSize                int
	CourseDiagnosticCatalogToken   string
	TZPlannerServiceURL            string
	TZPlannerServiceToken          string
	ProjectAuthoringHTTPTimeout    time.Duration
	ProjectAuthoringLeaseTTL       time.Duration
	ProjectAuthoringMaxAttempts    int
}

const minimumWorkerLeaseMargin = 20 * time.Second

func Load() (Config, error) {
	graphReadinessEnabled, err := boolean("PLANNER_GRAPH_READINESS_ENABLED", false)
	if err != nil {
		return Config{}, err
	}
	onboardingHandoffEnabled, err := boolean("PLANNER_ONBOARDING_HANDOFF_ENABLED", false)
	if err != nil {
		return Config{}, err
	}
	onboardingPathExecutionEnabled, err := boolean("PLANNER_ONBOARDING_PATH_EXECUTION_ENABLED", false)
	if err != nil {
		return Config{}, err
	}
	downstreamTimeout, err := duration("DOWNSTREAM_HTTP_TIMEOUT", 10*time.Second)
	if err != nil {
		return Config{}, err
	}
	projectAuthoringTimeout, err := duration("PROJECT_AUTHORING_HTTP_TIMEOUT", 20*time.Minute+30*time.Second)
	if err != nil {
		return Config{}, err
	}
	projectAuthoringLease, err := duration("PROJECT_AUTHORING_LEASE_TTL", 22*time.Minute)
	if err != nil {
		return Config{}, err
	}
	projectAuthoringAttempts, err := integer("PROJECT_AUTHORING_MAX_ATTEMPTS", 8)
	if err != nil {
		return Config{}, err
	}
	pollInterval, err := duration("WORKER_POLL_INTERVAL", 2*time.Second)
	if err != nil {
		return Config{}, err
	}
	leaseTTL, err := duration("WORKER_LEASE_TTL", 30*time.Second)
	if err != nil {
		return Config{}, err
	}
	maxAttempts, err := integer("WORKER_MAX_ATTEMPTS", 5)
	if err != nil {
		return Config{}, err
	}
	outboxPoll, err := duration("OUTBOX_POLL_INTERVAL", 500*time.Millisecond)
	if err != nil {
		return Config{}, err
	}
	outboxLock, err := duration("OUTBOX_LOCK_TTL", 5*time.Minute)
	if err != nil {
		return Config{}, err
	}
	outboxPublishTimeout, err := duration("OUTBOX_PUBLISH_TIMEOUT", 5*time.Second)
	if err != nil {
		return Config{}, err
	}
	outboxRetryBase, err := duration("OUTBOX_RETRY_BASE", time.Second)
	if err != nil {
		return Config{}, err
	}
	outboxRetryMax, err := duration("OUTBOX_RETRY_MAX", 5*time.Minute)
	if err != nil {
		return Config{}, err
	}
	outboxBatch, err := integer("OUTBOX_BATCH_SIZE", 50)
	if err != nil {
		return Config{}, err
	}
	result := Config{
		HTTPAddr:                       get("HTTP_ADDR", ":8080"),
		DatabaseURL:                    get("DATABASE_URL", "postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/learning_planner?sslmode=disable"),
		NATSURL:                        get("NATS_URL", "nats://localhost:4222"),
		InternalAPIToken:               strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("INTERNAL_API_TOKEN")),
		TeacherServiceToken:            strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("TEACHER_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN")),
		TeacherOnboardingHandoffToken:  strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("TEACHER_ONBOARDING_HANDOFF_INTERNAL_TOKEN")),
		PracticeServiceToken:           strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("PRACTICE_TASK_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN")),
		GraphReadinessEnabled:          graphReadinessEnabled,
		OnboardingHandoffEnabled:       onboardingHandoffEnabled,
		OnboardingPathExecutionEnabled: onboardingPathExecutionEnabled,
		StudentServiceURL:              get("STUDENT_SERVICE_URL", "http://localhost:8081"),
		StudentServiceToken:            strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("STUDENT_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN")),
		StudentServiceWriteToken:       strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("STUDENT_SERVICE_LEARNING_PLANNER_TOKEN")),
		CourseServiceURL:               get("COURSE_SERVICE_URL", "http://localhost:8082"),
		CourseServiceToken:             strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("COURSE_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN")),
		AIPromptServiceURL:             get("AI_PROMPT_SERVICE_URL", "http://localhost:8091"),
		AIPromptServiceToken:           strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("AI_PROMPT_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN")),
		DownstreamHTTPTimeout:          downstreamTimeout,
		WorkerPollInterval:             pollInterval,
		WorkerLeaseTTL:                 leaseTTL,
		WorkerMaxAttempts:              maxAttempts,
		OutboxPollInterval:             outboxPoll, OutboxLockTTL: outboxLock,
		CourseDiagnosticCatalogToken: strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("COURSE_DIAGNOSTIC_CATALOG_TOKEN")),
		TZPlannerServiceURL:          get("TZ_PLANNER_SERVICE_URL", "http://localhost:8092"),
		TZPlannerServiceToken:        strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("TZ_PLANNER_INTERNAL_TOKEN")),
		ProjectAuthoringHTTPTimeout:  projectAuthoringTimeout,
		ProjectAuthoringLeaseTTL:     projectAuthoringLease,
		ProjectAuthoringMaxAttempts:  projectAuthoringAttempts,
		OutboxPublishTimeout:         outboxPublishTimeout,
		OutboxRetryBase:              outboxRetryBase, OutboxRetryMax: outboxRetryMax, OutboxBatchSize: outboxBatch,
	}
	if err := result.Validate(); err != nil {
		return Config{}, err
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (config Config) Validate() error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(config.HTTPAddr) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(config.DatabaseURL) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(config.NATSURL) == "" ||
		config.InternalAPIToken == "" || config.TeacherServiceToken == "" || config.PracticeServiceToken == "" || config.StudentServiceToken == "" || config.StudentServiceWriteToken == "" || config.CourseServiceToken == "" || config.CourseDiagnosticCatalogToken == "" ||
		config.AIPromptServiceToken == "" ||
		config.DownstreamHTTPTimeout <= 0 || config.WorkerPollInterval <= 0 || config.WorkerLeaseTTL <= 0 ||
		config.TZPlannerServiceToken == "" || config.ProjectAuthoringHTTPTimeout <= 0 ||
		config.ProjectAuthoringLeaseTTL <= config.ProjectAuthoringHTTPTimeout || config.ProjectAuthoringMaxAttempts < 1 ||
		config.WorkerLeaseTTL < minimumWorkerLeaseMargin || config.DownstreamHTTPTimeout > config.WorkerLeaseTTL-minimumWorkerLeaseMargin || config.WorkerMaxAttempts < 1 || config.OutboxPollInterval <= 0 || config.OutboxLockTTL <= 0 ||
		config.OutboxPublishTimeout <= 0 || config.OutboxLockTTL <= time.Duration(config.OutboxBatchSize)*config.OutboxPublishTimeout ||
		config.OutboxRetryBase <= 0 || config.OutboxRetryMax < config.OutboxRetryBase || config.OutboxBatchSize < 1 {
		return errors.New("required service configuration is missing or invalid")
	}
	if config.InternalAPIToken == config.TeacherServiceToken || config.InternalAPIToken == config.PracticeServiceToken ||
		config.TeacherServiceToken == config.PracticeServiceToken || config.StudentServiceToken == config.StudentServiceWriteToken || config.CourseServiceToken == config.CourseDiagnosticCatalogToken {
		return errors.New("dedicated service tokens must be distinct")
	}
	if config.OnboardingHandoffEnabled && !config.GraphReadinessEnabled {
		return errors.New("PLANNER_ONBOARDING_HANDOFF_ENABLED requires PLANNER_GRAPH_READINESS_ENABLED")
	}
	if config.OnboardingPathExecutionEnabled && (!config.OnboardingHandoffEnabled || !config.GraphReadinessEnabled) {
		return errors.New("PLANNER_ONBOARDING_PATH_EXECUTION_ENABLED requires handoff and graph readiness")
	}
	if config.TeacherOnboardingHandoffToken != "" &&
		(config.TeacherOnboardingHandoffToken == config.InternalAPIToken || config.TeacherOnboardingHandoffToken == config.TeacherServiceToken ||
			config.TeacherOnboardingHandoffToken == config.PracticeServiceToken || config.TeacherOnboardingHandoffToken == config.StudentServiceToken ||
			config.TeacherOnboardingHandoffToken == config.StudentServiceWriteToken || config.TeacherOnboardingHandoffToken == config.CourseServiceToken ||
			config.TeacherOnboardingHandoffToken == config.CourseDiagnosticCatalogToken || config.TeacherOnboardingHandoffToken == config.TZPlannerServiceToken ||
			config.TeacherOnboardingHandoffToken == config.AIPromptServiceToken) {
		return errors.New("TEACHER_ONBOARDING_HANDOFF_INTERNAL_TOKEN must be distinct")
	}
	if config.OnboardingHandoffEnabled && config.TeacherOnboardingHandoffToken == "" {
		return errors.New("PLANNER_ONBOARDING_HANDOFF_ENABLED requires a distinct handoff token")
	}
	for _, token := range []string{config.InternalAPIToken, config.TeacherServiceToken, config.TeacherOnboardingHandoffToken, config.PracticeServiceToken, config.StudentServiceToken, config.StudentServiceWriteToken, config.CourseServiceToken, config.CourseDiagnosticCatalogToken, config.AIPromptServiceToken} {
		if config.TZPlannerServiceToken == token {
			return errors.New("TZ Planner token must be dedicated")
		}
	}
	for name, raw := range map[string]string{
		"STUDENT_SERVICE_URL":    config.StudentServiceURL,
		"COURSE_SERVICE_URL":     config.CourseServiceURL,
		"AI_PROMPT_SERVICE_URL":  config.AIPromptServiceURL,
		"TZ_PLANNER_SERVICE_URL": config.TZPlannerServiceURL,
	} {
		parsed, err := url.ParseRequestURI(raw)
		if err != nil || (parsed.Scheme != "http" && parsed.Scheme != "https") || parsed.Host == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s must be an absolute HTTP URL", name)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func get(name string, fallback string) string {
	if value := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(name)); value != "" {
		return value
	}
	return fallback
}

func duration(name string, fallback time.Duration) (time.Duration, error) {
	raw := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(name))
	if raw == "" {
		return fallback, nil
	}
	value, err := time.ParseDuration(raw)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", name, err)
	}
	return value, nil
}

func integer(name string, fallback int) (int, error) {
	raw := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(name))
	if raw == "" {
		return fallback, nil
	}
	value, err := strconv.Atoi(raw)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", name, err)
	}
	return value, nil
}

func boolean(name string, fallback bool) (bool, error) {
	raw := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(name))
	if raw == "" {
		return fallback, nil
	}
	if raw == "true" {
		return true, nil
	}
	if raw == "false" {
		return false, nil
	}
	return false, fmt.Errorf("%s must be true or false", name)
}
